input.free_text_description: This system is a search platform that serves Admin, Customer roles. It manages core business objects including order. The platform provides capabilities for elastic search, query, bulk processor. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to create and manage order records, so that I can track and organize order data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
